run_evaluation_cli: run the evaluate CLI to compute MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and FLIP metrics on trained models
generate_diff_and_flip_data: generate diff images and FLIP loss visualizations by comparing test output against reference images
calculate_image_quality_metrics: calculate MSE, PSNR, and SSIM quality metrics between rendered test images and ground truth references
evaluate_network_complexity: evaluate network complexity by counting FLOPs and MACs per image using ptflops on trained models
export_onnx_model: export the trained neural radiance field model to ONNX format for deployment
